Thanking you, Yours faithfully, For Oswal Pumps Limited Anish Kumar Company Secretary and Compliance Officer Encl.: As above Oswal Pumps to set up 1.2 GW TOPCon solar cell manufacturing facility; deepens backward integration across the solar value chain Karnal, Haryana, 10th October 2026: Oswal Pumps Limited, one of India's leading manufacturers of solar pumping systems, solar modules and electric motors, today announced that the Board of Directors of its wholly owned subsidiary, Oswal Solar Energy Private Limited ("OSEPL") has approved plans to set up a 1.2 GW solar cell manufacturing facility based on TOPCon (Tunnel Oxide Passivated Contact) technology. The commercial production is expected to commence by April 2028. The entire output is intended for captive consumption by OSEPL's in-house solar module lines. It is intended to secure a steady, reliable supply of DCR cells and reduce the Company's exposure to spot-market price volatility and supplier-driven commercial terms.
